title: Clearer setup and recovery
summary: SteamVR and vJoy setup are now explicit, guided, and easier to diagnose.
highlights: Added a clear Desktop, OpenXR, and SteamVR launch selector with a dedicated SteamVR launcher setup panel.
Added an in-app vJoy installation and device 1 configuration guide with a 128-button readiness check.
Page failures now show a recoverable error instead of a blank workspace, and updater preparation no longer blocks the interface.
